title: HTML escaping
body: escape(text): &, <, > and " for HTML. Everything else builds on it.

title: Block parser
body: parse_blocks(text) -> Document: headings, paragraphs, thematic breaks, fenced and indented code, block quotes, nested lists (tight and loose) and tables. See "Blocks" in SPEC.md. A large task: consider splitting it with a sketch (AGENTS.md), for instance one subtask per kind of block, each in its own module under mdlite/blocks/, with parse_blocks in mdlite/blocks/__init__.py trying each in turn. Quotes and list items contain blocks, so the parser calls itself.

title: Inline formatting
body: render_inline(text) -> HTML: escapes, code spans, emphasis and strong (nested, with CommonMark's flanking rules), strikethrough, links, images, autolinks and line breaks. See "Inline" in SPEC.md. A large task: consider splitting it with a sketch (AGENTS.md), for instance escapes and code spans, emphasis, and links and images, in modules under mdlite/inline/.

title: HTML renderer
body: render(doc, inline) -> HTML for every node in mdlite/nodes.py, with tight and loose lists and aligned tables. See "Rendering" in SPEC.md.

title: Heading ids and table of contents
body: slugify, add_ids (unique ids for top-level headings) and toc_html (nested lists). See "Table of contents" in SPEC.md.

title: Command line, and whole documents end to end
body: python -m mdlite FILE [-o OUT] [--toc] [--title TITLE], always UTF-8. Its acceptance also converts whole documents, so it's where the parts are proven to fit together: if a document test fails because of another part, report it (attempt.reported) with the exact input and output, so whoever holds that part can fix it.

title: Make mdlite fast
body: Lower the time bench_mdlite.py prints, without breaking any test. Profile first (python -m cProfile -s cumtime bench_mdlite.py).
